title: HTTM: gDNA Extraction
author: Antoine Champie
materials: Silica columns array are ready to be reused.

steps.title: Prepare lysis solution
steps.instruction: Add 165 µL proteinase K to 66 mL homemade lysis buffer and mix well to make the lysis solution.

steps.title: Add lysis solution to wells
steps.instruction: Add 600 µL of the prepared lysis solution to each well of the deep‑well plate and resuspend the pellet.

steps.title: Incubate lysis at 55 °C for 1 h
steps.instruction: Cover the plate with adhesive aluminum foil and incubate at 55 °C for 01:00:00.

steps.title: Add ethanol while warm
steps.instruction: While still warm, add 260 µL of 100 % ethanol to each well, avoiding overmixing.

steps.title: Transfer to silica column plate
steps.instruction: Immediately transfer the contents to a deep‑well plate fitted with an array of silica columns.

steps.title: Centrifuge twice to bind DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the plate at 3270 × g, °C, for 10 minutes; repeat the centrifugation for a second 10‑minute run.

steps.title: Discard flowthrough and add wash
steps.instruction: Discard the flowthrough and add 500 µL of wash solution to each well.

steps.title: Centrifuge to collect wash
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 3000 × g, °C, for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Centrifuge to remove residual wash
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 3000 × g, °C, for 5 minutes to eliminate traces of wash solution.

steps.title: Insert collector plate
steps.instruction: Place a collector plate between the silica column array and the deep‑well plate.

steps.title: Add low TE elution buffer
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of low TE buffer to the silica matrix in each well.

steps.title: Incubate elution at 55 °C for 15 min
steps.instruction: Cover with adhesive aluminum foil and incubate at 55 °C for 00:15:00.

steps.title: Centrifuge to collect eluate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 3270 × g, °C, for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Add NaOH/Triton decontamination solution
steps.instruction: Place the contaminated silica array on an empty deep‑well plate and add 150 µL of 1 N NaOH + 0.15 % (v/v) Triton X‑100 to each well.

substeps.instruction: Place silica array on empty plate
Add 150 µL 1 N NaOH + 0.15 % Triton X‑100

steps.title: Incubate decontamination at room temp
steps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature for 00:05:00.

steps.title: Add HCl/Triton neutralization solution
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of 1.5 N HCl + 0.15 % (v/v) Triton X‑100 to each well.

steps.title: Centrifuge after neutralization
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 3000 × g, °C, for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Incubate at room temperature
steps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature for 00:30:00.

steps.title: Centrifuge after incubation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 3000 × g, °C, for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Add second NaOH/Triton solution
steps.instruction: Add 150 µL of 1 N NaOH + 0.15 % (v/v) Triton X‑100 to each well.

steps.title: Incubate second decontamination
steps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature for 00:05:00.

steps.title: Centrifuge final decontamination
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 3000 × g, °C, for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Collect flowthrough and neutralize if needed
steps.instruction: Collect the flowthrough in a beaker, neutralize the pH if necessary, and dispose of the flowthrough.

steps.title: Add ddH2O to wells
steps.instruction: Add 600 µL of ddH₂O to each well.

steps.title: Centrifuge final eluate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 3000 × g, °C, for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Repeat wash centrifugation steps
steps.instruction: Repeat the centrifugation twice at 3270 × g for 10 minutes each (as in step 6) and then discard the flowthrough and add 500 µL wash solution (as in step 7).

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge twice at 3270 × g, 10 min each
Discard flowthrough and add 500 µL wash solution
